newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman stocks up 0.7 pct in trade led by bank sector.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks up 0.7 pct in trade led by bank sector.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange gained ground in the week to Wednesday, with trade dominated by banking and investment company stocks, a Muscat Securities Market report said.
The stock exchange index ended the week at 312.80 points, up 0.7 percent from the previous week's close of 310.72.
Banks and investment companies accounted for 75 percent of the total value traded in the week, put at 19.3 million rials ($51 million).
Of the 75 stocks traded in the week, 32 rose, 29 declined and 14 were unchanged.
Al Ahlia Portfolio Securities ended the week at 8.070 rials up from 7.950 a week ago, with 143,000 shares worth 1.075 million rials changing hands.
National Bank of Oman continued the previous week's advance and closed at 8.180 from 8.050 last week.
Oman National Holding closed 0.350 rials higher at 5.700 rials.
National Biscuit Industries rose 0.300 rials to end the week at 5.200 rials. ($1=0.377 rials)
